description: This file defines a background task class 'ResizedMediaCacheBackgroundTask' for cleaning up resized media cache in OrchardCore CMS. It implements scheduled cache cleanup logic, deleting old cache files and directories based on configured age and stale parameters.

classes.name: ResizedMediaCacheBackgroundTask
classes.description: A background task class that periodically cleans up old resized media cache files and directories based on configured age and stale parameters.

methods.name: ResizedMediaCacheBackgroundTask
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cache paths, options, and logger.

methods.name: DoWorkAsync
methods.description: Performs the cache cleanup asynchronously, deleting outdated cache files and directories.
